email.body1:
Igor, saw MetaMask just launched Agent Wallet in early access, letting AI agents transact across DeFi.

A launch like that opens far more in-market accounts than a BD team can cover before the window closes, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for MetaMask off your ecosystem's hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Igor, quick follow-up on MetaMask.

New product, new buyers, but BD coverage rarely scales as fast as the demand a launch creates. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to capitalize on the moment, so the gap shows up late and the window passes.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings MetaMask needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Igor, last bit of proof for MetaMask.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how MetaMask's reply rate likely compares to other fast-moving platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Igor, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. A fresh launch is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your BD motion? I'll tailor it to MetaMask either way.
